description: Record that a person asked us to stop contacting them. This is the SUPPORTED way to honour an opt-out: it writes a person-level do-not-contact record for every identifier on the lead (email, phone, LinkedIn) AND fences the lead, in one transaction. Prefer this over update_lead(takeover_source='opt_out'), which only labels one lead row and gates nothing.

id.description: UUID of the lead who asked us to stop

reason.description: Optional short note for the record, e.g. the words they used. Defaults to 'unsubscribed'.

name: opt_out_lead
